observable_effects: reads the chip identifier through the I2C client at haptic offset 0x328 and writes register 0x47
computes and saturates the derived period value at 0x7f
reads registers 7 and 10 and stores their byte/eight-byte results into haptic state
applies stock bit updates and ordered writes to protection, VBAT reference, and calibration registers
I2C helper return values are ignored
limitations: Register writes are reconstructed from static evidence; no device hardware validation is claimed.
